verdict.rationale: Cerebras offers a no-key playground in the Cloud Console and $5 free credits explicitly for prototyping 'agents and real-time apps before you spend a dollar,' which functions as a lightweight sandbox for experimentation before committing to paid/production usage. However, there is no dedicated 'sandbox environment,' test API keys, or explicit separation from production data/endpoints as a first-class feature. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-mode distinct from production endpoints, documentation on isolating test data from production dedicated endpoints, and any independent confirmation of this workflow.
